metadata.name: PostPurchaseTransaction
metadata.description: This API is used to post a purchase transaction.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Account Number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:7485122

request_fields.name: MerchantID
request_fields.description: Unique number of merchant account. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:6051

request_fields.name: EffectiveDateTime
request_fields.description: Effective Date of Transaction Valid Values:01/15/2020 Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: StoreID
request_fields.description: Specific code assigned to a Store. Valid Values:XXX Format:0-9 Example:1234

request_fields.name: RegisterID
request_fields.description: Unique ID assigned to a Register. Valid Values: a-z 0-9 Format:xxxxx Example:123456 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: InvoiceNumber
request_fields.description: Invoice Number for Transaction Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:987567757 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: TransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Amount of Transaction. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:500.00

request_fields.name: TransactionDescription
request_fields.description: User defined description of transaction if entered by user explicitly. If not entered by the user, then system will generate it. For example Purchase/Payment. Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:Purchase/Payment. Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: TransmissionDateTime
request_fields.description: Time when transaction was originated Valid Values:12-30-2015T13:05:10 Format:MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm:ss Example:12/30/2015 13:05:10

request_fields.name: TransactionCode
request_fields.description: Transaction Code for the posting of Single Transaction. Valid Values:  A-Z 0-9 Format: xxxxxxx Example:427248 = Principal Adjustment Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SignatureJSON
request_fields.description: Signature captured in JSON format. A URL will be provided wihch can be used to generate the signature in JSON. Valid Values:a-z 0-9 Format: xxxx Example: abc123 Condition: A setup is required in CoreIssue System to enable/disable this feature. Allowable Values: 10000

request_fields.name: SignaturePNG
request_fields.description: Send Binary data in this tag. A URL will be provided wihch can be used to generate the signature. Valid Values:a-z 0-9 Format: xxxx Example: abc123 Condition: A setup is required in CoreIssue System to enable/disable this feature. Allowable Values: 10000

request_fields.name: CreditPlanMaster
request_fields.description: Plan name associated with the card account. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:5244 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Number which is assigned to a Merchant. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:6051 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: ProcedureCompletedorScheduled
request_fields.description: Determines that the Procedure for which the Purchase Transaction posted is completed/scheduled or not Valid Values:0- Yes and 1-No Example:1 Condition:When the api is used for posting a Purchase Transaction type and If on Product in CI, the field 'MTA Enabled' on Post Purchase Txn Panel is checked If the MTAcode of the Merchant must be '3000' under which the Transaction is Even If either one of the above conditions is not fulfilled, then the tag 'ProcedureCompleted/Scheduled' must not be mandatory.

request_fields.name: StoreNumber
request_fields.description: Unique Number which is assigned to a Store. Valid Values:0-9 Example:1234 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: UniqueId
request_fields.description: Unique ID is a transaction specific unique ID. This ID is unique for every transaction. If multiple calls are made by client for a specific transaction, the value of this tag will always be the same for a specific transaction. (GUID and UUID datatypes are supported for this tag). Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: F965C56F-C58F-EC11-B80E-A4BF010A357E Condition: If API user opts in for Idempotency feature i.e., if next versioning of the APIs i.e 3.0 is provided, this tag will be mandatory. If this API is executed with previous version below 3.0, and if the Unique Id is provided in the API, idempotency feature will not be considered and the unique id will be ignored Allowable Values: 40

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Transaction Number for transaction being posted. Valid Values:0-9 a-z Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:23654789 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: TransactionDescription
children.description: User defined description of transaction if entered by user explicitly. If not entered by the user, then system will generate it. For example Purchase/Payment. Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:Purchase/Payment. Allowable Values: 100

children.name: DeclineReason
children.description: Specific reason for the decline of transaction posting. Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:abc123 Allowable Values: 100

children.name: ResponseCode
children.description: This number will ensure that API hit our internal servers. This will always be unique. It can also be null when API is returned from our external servers Example - If we pass blank User ID and Password in input then this will be null. This ID can be used for tracking purpose of any request hit the Core Card internal servers. Allowable Values: 20

children.name: PostingReference
children.description: Posting reference (Like -Transaction Posted Successfully) Valid Values: A-Z 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: Transaction Posted Successfully Allowable Values: 20
